topic: The Five Senses and Their Care
key_concepts: The five sense organs are the eyes, ears, nose, tongue, and skin
The eye has parts including cornea, iris, pupil, lens, retina, and optic nerve
The optic nerve carries visual messages from the eye to the brain
The ear has parts including pinna, ear canal, eardrum, hammer, anvil, stirrup, cochlea, an
The eardrum vibrates and the three small ear bones amplify sound
The cochlea senses vibrations and the auditory nerve sends sound messages to the brain
The nose has nostrils, nasal passages, nasal cavity, and olfactory nerves for smelling and
Nose hairs and mucus membrane filter dust, dirt, and germs
Taste buds on the tongue detect sweet, sour, salty, and bitter tastes

Proper care of sense organs includes avoiding loud sounds, sharp objects, and dirty habits
